name: Pro-Ship Incorporated
summary: Pro-Ship Incorporated develops, distributes, consults on and customizes software packages, mainly for asset and sales management. Its ProPlus Series includes the ProPlus Fixed Assets Suite for integrated asset management and ProPlusPit for asset inventory. Dating from 1969 as Japan M.I.S. Co., Ltd., it took its present name in May 2001 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
